requirements.statement: Staff request equipment loans by choosing an item and the loan dates.
requirements.source_quote: Staff request equipment loans by choosing an item and the loan dates.
ambiguity_notes: Which items can be chosen (catalogue, source, availability) is not defined.
Loan dates are not defined: start and end, limits, minimum or maximum duration.
Whether one request can cover more than one item is not stated.

requirements.statement: Line managers approve or decline loan requests.
requirements.source_quote: Line managers approve or decline loan requests.
ambiguity_notes: Which line manager acts on a request (the requester's own, any, a delegate) is not stated.
Whether a reason is required or recorded when declining is not stated.
What happens after approval or decline (notification, reservation of the item, changing a decision) is not stated.

requirements.statement: Staff can see the status of their loan requests.
requirements.source_quote: Staff can see the status of their loan requests.
ambiguity_notes: The set of statuses is not defined.
Whether staff see only their own requests, and any decline reason, is not stated.

clarifying_questions.question: Which equipment items can staff choose from, and how is the list of items and their availability maintained?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Determines the data the request depends on and whether unavailable items can be requested.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The item selection cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: What rules apply to loan dates (start and end date, minimum or maximum length, dates in the past, overlapping loans of the same item)?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Changes validation and conflict behaviour of the request.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Date validation and clash handling cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: Which line manager can approve or decline a given request, and can a manager act for another or delegate?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines roles and permissions for approval.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Who may approve cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: Must a reason be given when declining, and should staff be notified of a decision and see the reason?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Affects data captured, notifications and what staff see.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Decline flow and feedback to staff stay undefined.

clarifying_questions.question: Which statuses should a loan request have (for example pending, approved, declined), and can staff cancel or change a request?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines the state model shown to staff.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The status list cannot be specified.

proposed_status_changes.reason: Items and date rules are not defined (CQ-001, CQ-002).
Which line manager may approve is not defined (CQ-003).
The set of statuses is not defined (CQ-005).
